name: Mechanical & Aerospace Atlas
card_name_zh: 机械与航空航天工程图谱
desc: A detailed, interactive course through university mechanical and aerospace engineering: from statics and dynamics to mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, fluids, heat transfer, design, control, aerodynamics and propulsion.
desc_zh: 深入、可交互的大学机械与航空航天工程课程：从静力学和动力学，到材料力学、热力学、流体力学、传热学、设计、控制、空气动力学与推进。
lede: A detailed, interactive course through university mechanical and aerospace engineering — from statics and dynamics to mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and heat transfer, materials and manufacturing, machine design, control and robotics, aerodynamics, propulsion and orbital mechanics. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 深入、可交互的大学机械与航空航天工程课程——从静力学和动力学，到材料力学、热力学、流体力学与传热学、材料与制造、机械设计、控制与机器人、空气动力学、推进与轨道力学。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive tour of the undergraduate mechanical and aerospace engineering curriculum, written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的大学本科机械与航空航天工程课程导览，可配合课堂和教材阅读。
about_lede: Mechanical & Aerospace Atlas is a free, detailed tour of the mechanical and aerospace engineering taught in a university degree — written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 机械与航空航天图谱是一套免费、详尽的大学机械与航空航天工程导览——可以配合课堂和教材阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From Archimedes’ levers to steam engines, powered flight and spaceflight: the ideas behind every course in the atlas.
timeline_desc_zh: 从阿基米德的杠杆到蒸汽机、动力飞行与航天：图谱中每门课程背后的思想。
timeline_title: Timeline of mechanical and aerospace engineering
timeline_title_zh: 机械与航空航天工程时间线
timeline_lede: The ideas behind the courses, from levers and gears to the steam engine, the theory of elasticity, powered flight, the jet engine and spaceflight. Coloured dots show the area; links lead to the course where the idea is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的思想：从杠杆和齿轮，到蒸汽机、弹性理论、动力飞行、喷气发动机与航天飞行。彩色圆点表示所属领域；链接指向讲授该内容的课程。
card_desc: University mechanical and aerospace engineering: solid mechanics, dynamics and vibration, thermodynamics, fluids and heat transfer, materials and manufacturing, design, control and robotics, aerodynamics, propulsion and orbits. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 大学机械与航空航天工程：固体力学、动力学与振动、热力学、流体与传热、材料与制造、设计、控制与机器人、空气动力学、推进与轨道。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

areas.label: Solid mechanics
areas.blurb: Forces, stress and strain, and how structures carry load.
areas.blurb_zh: 力、应力与应变，以及结构如何承受载荷。

areas.label: Dynamics & vibration
areas.blurb: Motion of particles, rigid bodies and mechanisms, and their vibration.
areas.blurb_zh: 质点、刚体与机构的运动及其振动。

areas.label: Thermofluids
areas.blurb: Energy, heat and the flow of fluids.

areas.label: Materials & manufacturing
areas.blurb: What engineering materials are made of, and how parts are made.
areas.blurb_zh: 工程材料的构成，以及零件如何制造。

areas.label: Design
areas.blurb: Drawing, designing and specifying machines that work.
areas.blurb_zh: 绘图、设计与规定能可靠工作的机器。

areas.label: Control & robotics
areas.blurb: Sensing, actuation, feedback control and robots.
areas.blurb_zh: 传感、驱动、反馈控制与机器人。

areas.label: Aerospace
areas.blurb: Aircraft and spacecraft: aerodynamics, propulsion, flight and orbits.
areas.blurb_zh: 飞机与航天器：空气动力学、推进、飞行与轨道。
